input.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 photo, a single frame from a phone-shot mirror video. Image 1 is the real product reference sheet (top photo = the real front), image 2 a real close-up of the flat fabric tie, image 3 a real close-up of the front ruching: the skirt MUST match images 1-3 exactly in shape, ruching, ties and dark brown colour. Image 4 is Grace's hand sheet: her hands MUST match it (skin, short nude-pink French-tip nails, the same rings: blue silicone band, solitaire ring, stacked diamond band, gold heart ring; flat gold link bracelet and pearl chain with a gold leaf charm on her left wrist). No other jewellery.
SKIRT (MUST match the real product photos, colour for colour): the real DARK CHOCOLATE BROWN skirt (deep brown like dark chocolate, about RGB 66,49,44), lightweight polyester with a soft low sheen, NOT black, NOT satin-shiny, NOT leather. Four vertical drawstring channels (two on the front, one on each side) gather the fabric into soft horizontal ruching; each channel ends at the waistband in a FLAT brown fabric tie (thin flat strap, same brown, not a round cord) with two hanging ends. Ruffle-trimmed hems. The back is longer, with four horizontal ruffle tiers. A semi-sheer brown inner layer shows under the front hem. Plain solid brown: no print, no lace, no buckles, no logo, no text.
PERSON: Grace, a slim woman with medium-dark brown skin, smooth bare legs. Plain black fitted long-sleeve top tucked into the skirt.
BOOTS: black matte leather KNEE-HIGH boots, the boot top ends just below the knee, flat chunky black lug sole, NO high heel, no buckles, no laces, no logo.
ROOM: bright white bedroom in daylight, light oak wood floor, white bed with white linen bedding behind her on the left, plain white wall, soft window light from the left. Photo taken in a full-length mirror; the thin black metal mirror frame edge shows down the right side of the frame. Her phone is above the frame, never visible.
LOOK: vertical 9:16 iPhone mirror photo, waist down only: the top edge of the frame cuts at her waist, the bottom edge shows the floor under her boots. Bright, neutral, natural colour, no yellow or golden tint, no dark or moody grade. No face, no text, no captions, no watermark.
SHOT S2: she stands facing the mirror, feet a little apart. Both hands grip the two FRONT fabric tie ends at the waistband, pinched between thumb and curled fingers, pulling them straight up; whole wrists visible, her arms come in from the sides of the frame. The skirt is still long at the front: the front hem hangs at her lower calf over the boots, the back hem reaches her ankles.
